checks.s: The SPA preamble identifies Verdantis Holdings, Inc. as a Delaware corporation and designates it as the Buyer.
The SPA preamble identifies Calyx Biomedical Systems, Inc. as a California corporation and designates it as the Company.
The SPA preamble identifies Dr. Maren E. Solberg as an individual and as a Seller.
The SPA preamble identifies Pinecrest Venture Fund III, L.P. as a Delaware limited partnership and as a Seller.
The SPA preamble identifies Thornfield Family Trust u/a/d 03/15/2018 as a California irrevocable trust, names Gerald R. Thornfield as Trustee, and designates the trust as a Seller.
The Purchase and Sale article states an Aggregate Purchase Price of $187,500,000 payable entirely in cash at Closing.
The SPA states a per-share price of $18.75 on an as-converted basis and references 10,000,000 total shares on an as-converted basis.
The SPA allocates to Dr. Maren E. Solberg 4,500,000 shares of Common Stock with gross proceeds of $84,375,000.
The SPA allocates to Pinecrest Venture Fund III, L.P. 3,800,000 shares of Series B Preferred Stock with gross proceeds of $71,250,000.
The SPA allocates to Thornfield Family Trust 1,700,000 shares of Series A Preferred Stock with gross proceeds of $31,875,000.
The SPA provides for a General Indemnity Escrow of $18,750,000, equal to 10% of the Aggregate Purchase Price, withheld pro rata from each Seller's proceeds at Closing.
The SPA provides that 50% of the General Indemnity Escrow is released on the 12-month anniversary of Closing and the remaining 50% on the 18-month anniversary of Closing, each net of pending claims.
The SPA provides for a separate Special Tax Indemnity Escrow of $5,625,000, equal to 3% of the Aggregate Purchase Price.
The SPA provides that 100% of the Tax Indemnity Escrow is released on the 24-month anniversary of Closing, net of pending claims.
The SPA identifies Continental Fiduciary Trust Company as Escrow Agent for both escrow accounts.
The working capital adjustment provisions set the Net Working Capital Target at $14,200,000.
The SPA provides for a ±$250,000 collar, with no adjustment for a variance within ±$250,000 and a dollar-for-dollar adjustment for amounts beyond the collar.
The SPA requires Sellers to deliver an Estimated Closing NWC statement at least 3 business days prior to Closing.
The SPA gives Buyer 90 calendar days after Closing to deliver the final Closing NWC statement.
The SPA provides the Sellers' Representative a 30-day review period after receiving the final Closing NWC statement.
The SPA designates BDO Alder & Co. LLP as the Independent Accounting Firm for NWC disputes.
The indemnification article provides that general representations survive for 18 months from Closing.
The SPA provides that Fundamental Representations survive for 36 months from Closing and defines them to include Organization, Authorization, Capitalization, Tax, and Brokers.
The SPA provides that claims based on fraud or willful misconduct survive indefinitely and are not subject to any cap on liability.
The SPA sets the General Indemnity Basket at $1,875,000 (1% of $187,500,000) and structures it as a true deductible, not a tipping or first-dollar basket.
The SPA sets the General Indemnity Cap at $18,750,000 (10% of the Aggregate Purchase Price).
The SPA sets the Fundamental Representation Cap at $93,750,000 (50% of the Aggregate Purchase Price).
The SPA provides that the Tax Indemnity Cap equals the Special Tax Escrow amount of $5,625,000 for 24 months from Closing and then reduces to $0.
The SPA includes an exclusive remedy provision for indemnification claims with express carve-outs for fraud, willful misconduct, equitable relief, and purchase price adjustments.
The SPA designates Dr. Maren E. Solberg as the Sellers' Representative.

The SPA grants the Sellers' Representative authority to bind all Sellers on post-closing indemnification claims, escrow releases, working capital adjustment disputes, and all other post-closing matters.
The capitalization representation recites 22,000,000 authorized shares: 12,000,000 Common, 5,000,000 Series A Preferred, and 5,000,000 Series B Preferred.

The capitalization representation states that Dr. Solberg holds 4,500,000 outstanding Common shares, Thornfield Trust holds 1,700,000 outstanding Series A Preferred shares with a 1:1 conversion ratio, and Pinecrest holds 3,800,000 outstanding Series B Preferred shares with a 1:1 conversion ratio.
The capitalization representation affirmatively states that no options, warrants, convertible securities, or treasury shares are outstanding.
The SPA states that the 2019 Equity Incentive Plan was terminated effective December 31, 2024, with all options exercised or cancelled.
Buyer's conditions to Closing include receipt of consent from Pacific Ridge Bank, N.A. under the Credit Agreement's change-of-control provision.
Buyer's conditions to Closing include receipt of consent from Medara Health Network, Inc. under the Master Supply Agreement dated January 15, 2023, pursuant to its anti-assignment clause.
Buyer's conditions to Closing include receipt of consent from Ridgeline Commercial Properties, LP, as landlord, for the Irvine facility lease pursuant to its anti-assignment clause.
The SPA requires payoff of the $6,800,000 Pacific Ridge Bank indebtedness at Closing from Sellers' proceeds.

A condition to Buyer's obligation to close requires execution and delivery of Dr. Solberg's post-closing employment agreement, with a 2-year term as President of the Calyx Biomedical Systems division, base salary of $475,000/year, and a sign-on equity grant of 50,000 restricted shares of Verdantis common stock.

A separate condition to Buyer's obligation to close requires Dr. Solberg to execute a 2-year non-competition and non-solicitation agreement covering the medical diagnostic device field in the United States.

The SPA includes a post-closing covenant requiring Buyer to obtain or maintain a 6-year D&O tail insurance policy for Calyx's pre-closing directors and officers, at Buyer's cost and capped at $385,000.
The closing conditions include an HSR Act filing or HSR waiting-period expiration requirement.
The SPA includes a comprehensive representation on FDA/regulatory compliance that references or preserves 510(k) clearances.
The IP representation or a related disclosure schedule references 7 issued U.S. utility patents and 3 pending patent applications.
The IP representation or a related disclosure schedule references 4 registered U.S. trademarks, including CALYX and RAPIDFLEX.
The IP representation references trade secrets, including proprietary spectral analysis algorithms.
The IP representation states that there are no known IP litigation or infringement claims.

The material contracts representation, directly or by cross-reference to disclosure schedules, covers the Medara MSA, Kaelum OEM Agreement, Pacific Ridge Credit Agreement, Ridgeline facility lease, and Ariston software license.
The SPA defines the Sellers' knowledge qualifier as limited to actual knowledge and imposes a duty of reasonable inquiry only on Dr. Solberg, not on other Sellers.

The SPA states that the Company's transaction expenses, estimated at $2,150,000, are borne by Sellers through either deduction from Sellers' proceeds at Closing or a Seller obligation to cause the Company to pay all transaction expenses prior to Closing.
The SPA's governing law clause specifies the laws of the State of Delaware.
The SPA's dispute resolution clause provides for exclusive jurisdiction in the Delaware Court of Chancery.
The Escrow Agreement exhibit or Form of Escrow Agreement attached to the SPA is governed by New York law.
The termination article includes an Outside Date of October 31, 2025.
The SPA references a Closing Date of August 29, 2025 (or 45 calendar days post-signing), or an earlier date when all conditions are satisfied or waived.
The SPA references July 15, 2025 as the date of execution or as the date of the agreement.
The notice provisions list Verdantis Holdings, Inc. at 200 Innovation Drive, Suite 1400, King of Prussia, PA 19406.
The notice provisions list Calyx Biomedical Systems, Inc. at 4700 Spectrum Center Drive, Suite 300, Irvine, CA 92618.
The notice provisions list Pinecrest Venture Fund III, L.P. at 1500 Sand Hill Road, Suite 210, Menlo Park, CA 94025.
The notice provisions list Thornfield Family Trust (Gerald R. Thornfield, Trustee) at 891 Bayside Terrace, Newport Beach, CA 92660.
The notice provisions include a copy to Mercer & Halston LLP, 1700 Market Street, Suite 3200, Philadelphia, PA 19103, for Buyer.
The notice provisions include a copy to Whitfield Dey & Associates, P.C., 355 South Grand Avenue, Suite 4100, Los Angeles, CA 90071, for Sellers.
The signature block for Verdantis Holdings, Inc. lists Nathan R. Calloway as signatory with the title SVP Corporate Development or Senior Vice President, Corporate Development.
The signature blocks include Dr. Maren E. Solberg signing in her individual capacity as a Seller and as Sellers' Representative.
The signature block for Pinecrest Venture Fund III, L.P. lists David K. Oshiro as signatory with the title Managing Partner of its general partner.
The signature block for Thornfield Family Trust u/a/d 03/15/2018 lists Gerald R. Thornfield as signatory in the capacity of Trustee.
The signature block for Calyx Biomedical Systems, Inc. lists Dr. Maren E. Solberg as signatory with the title CEO.
The SPA references and includes as an exhibit or attachment a Form of Escrow Agreement naming Continental Fiduciary Trust Company as Escrow Agent.

The SPA references and includes as an exhibit or attachment a Form of Non-Competition Agreement for Dr. Solberg with a 2-year restricted period covering the medical diagnostic device field in the United States.
The SPA references a Form of Employment Agreement for Dr. Solberg as an exhibit or attachment.
The SPA references a Disclosure Schedules framework, whether as a separate exhibit, attachment, or defined term with schedule references throughout.
The recitals state that the transaction is structured as a stock purchase to preserve Calyx's 510(k) clearances and/or key customer contracts.

The material contracts representation or a disclosure schedule references the Medara Health Network Master Supply Agreement dated January 15, 2023, approximately $22M in annual revenue, and that consent is required.
The material contracts representation or a disclosure schedule references the Kaelum OEM Manufacturing Agreement dated March 1, 2021, as amended June 12, 2024, for sole-source sensor arrays.

The material contracts representation or a disclosure schedule references the Pacific Ridge Bank Credit Agreement dated September 8, 2022 (reference CFA-2022-09085), with $6,800,000 outstanding and a change-of-control provision requiring consent and payoff.

The material contracts representation or a disclosure schedule references the Ridgeline Commercial Properties facility lease dated April 1, 2020, expiring March 31, 2028, at $67,500/month, and requiring landlord consent.
The material contracts representation or a disclosure schedule references the Ariston software license agreement dated November 1, 2023, at $840,000/year and auto-renewing January 1.
The financial statements representation references Calyx's fiscal year 2024 audited financials for the year ended December 31, 2024, with revenue of $62,500,000.
The financial statements representation references Calyx total assets of $22,300,000.
The SPA includes an absence of changes or absence of certain changes representation covering the period from December 31, 2024 through the Closing Date.
